items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: Oh, Bockeyes. Yeah, old man Peter Bockeye, he got a son. All of them, he comes over the river.

ctx.x: You called them Bockeyes? Yeah, I come up with them.
Oh, Bockeyes. Yeah, old man Peter Bockeye, he got a son. All of them, he comes over the river. Yeah, and he still lives over there. Yeah, I live with him.
Yeah, I know. Did you know Manetta? Mania Manetta?
